description: Sends a real request through the proxy to fingerprinting endpoints and compares what they observe (TTL, window, MSS, window scale, option order, OS guess) with the applied profile, for example to confirm set_tcp_fingerprint took effect. Slow: up to ~45 seconds. Results are cached for 60 seconds per proxy. One proxy per call, mobile or server only.

proxy_id.description: Mobile or server proxy_id from list_proxies

name: diagnose_tcp_fingerprint
title: Check the TCP fingerprint a site sees
